misleading_abstract.source: Abstract mentions a restricted trend. Methods and generality require body access; no body was read.

left.claim_text: Synthetic estimator is reliable in all energy regimes.

duplicate_urls.source: The same synthetic DOI is linked through two public URLs, with identical bibliographic metadata.

wrong_doi.source: The reviewed catalog identifies synthetic-a; the extracted atom cites a different DOI.

metadata_inconsistency.source: The DOI registry metadata supplied by the reviewer has a different title and author from the candidate.

equation_conventions.source: Synthetic y=x+1 uses entry origin; y=x_prime+2 uses an origin shifted by one. A reviewer must reconstruct the transformation.

different_observables.source: Synthetic maximum particle number is at 5 cm; maximum deposited energy is at 7 cm. These are distinct observables.

right.claim_text: Synthetic maximum energy deposition is at 7 cm.
right.evidence_excerpt: Synthetic maximum deposited energy at 7 cm.

different_energy_regimes.source: One synthetic paper covers 1–10 GeV; another covers 100–1000 GeV. Target portability requires separate review.

right.claim_text: Synthetic depth is 8 cm in the high-energy regime.

genuine_disagreement.source: Two independent synthetic sources report 5 cm and 8 cm for matched observables, regimes, conventions, models and controlled assumptions. Disagreement remains.

unresolved_access.source: Only citation metadata is available; no abstract or body can be read. No support is attested.

citation_drift.source: Original synthetic paper reports a restricted trend; a later citation claims universal reliability. Independent semantic review records OVERSTATED, not EXACT_SUPPORT.
